snippet.title: Lightkeeper's Curse: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Uncover the Mystery. Escape the Curse.
Step into the haunting world of Lightkeeper’s Curse — a dark fantasy puzzle adventure where danger lurks in the shadows of a cursed keep. Solve intricate puzzles, navigate eerie environments, and uncover the tragic story that binds the keep’s past to your fate.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375630?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=trailer
